description: What one call costs on the pay-as-you-go plan, by cost band. FREE — and deliberately so: an agent that learns a price only when it is refused has already been refused by its own wallet. Call this BEFORE budgeting a run of paid tools. Returns the bands (free catalog reads, single-entity synthesis, cross-catalog synthesis, per-row bulk) and every priced resource key. Under an Understanding or Influence subscription these calls are included in the plan; these prices are what per-call access costs. The same map prices x402 payments and the x-price-usd header, so all three agree.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.
